remarks: Fantastic 4-Bedroom home in South Wilton on a serene Cul-de-Sac. Nestled at the end of a long, private driveway in sought-after location, this freshly painted 4-bedroom residence offers the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and convenience. As a commuter's dream, this home is ideally positioned for easy walk to town access, yet provides a peaceful sanctuary away from the hustle and bustle. Step inside to discover an updated, flexible floor plan that caters to modern living. The potential first-level Master Suite is complete with an updated Full Bath, chic grey plank flooring and provides complete privacy. A cozy fireplace to warm up those chilly evenings makes the spacious Family room a place to gather. Convenient Laundry Room also offers direct access to the outdoors. Ascend to the second level where the living space unfolds in an open and inviting manner. Hardwood floors and elegant raised panel molding add a touch of sophistication to the formal Living and Dining Rooms. Sliders frame the view of your private front yard, inviting you to bask in the natural light. The heart of the home, the Eat-In Kitchen, is equipped with brand-new Kitchen-Aid stainless steel appliances, fresh flooring, and a door that opens onto a generous back deck. Imagine summer BBQs and tranquil moments spent overlooking the flat and usable backyard. 3 additional bedrooms, with ample storage, a second updated Full Bath complete this turnkey home!
